export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'ticket_create') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }

  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');

    throw new Error('title is required and must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if (typeof description !== 'string' || description.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('description is required and must be a non-empty string');
  }

  const allowed = new Set(['title', 'description', 'priority']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }

  const prio = priority === undefined ? 'normal' : priority;
  if (!['low', 'normal', 'high'].includes(prio)) {
    throw new Error('priority must be one of: low, normal, high');
  }

  const id = `t${nextId++}`;
  const text = `Created ticket ${id} (priority: ${prio}): ${title}`;

  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text }]
  };
}
